text.p: Portugal gained with Spain and the narrowing of the spread between the two markets' 10-year cash leaves Portugal with the potential to outperform its neighbour, traders said.
"The narrowing of the spread...makes (Portugal) attractive and with the potential to gain, above all if Spain consolidates its rise," said one trader.
"The spread in the 10-year should be between zero and five basis points negative if Spain gains. It is falls, the spread should widen to minus 10," he added.
The spread had narrowed to minus three from minus five basis points on Friday, reflecting the lack of liquidity in the Portuguese market.
Traders said the trend in the short-end would depend on the outcome of the Treasury's three-year auction on Tuesday.
